article_context: Body image after the expert explanation of family-mortgage affordability; it visualizes a modern Moscow residential complex as a tangible, comfortable home purchase.
image_reading: Three modern high-rise residential towers viewed from across a quiet street at warm late-afternoon light.
The towers are the clear focal point; visible trees, a few pedestrians and a car provide subtle foreground motion opportunities.

models.positive_prompt: A slow forward camera move toward the residential towers, with light leaf movement and pedestrians continuing naturally across the forecourt. End with the sunlit complex prominently framed and clearly recognizable.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, make one gentle forward push toward the central residential towers to turn the development into a more immediate destination. The movement begins at once and remains even; nearby leaves and the small pedestrians retain subtle natural motion. Near the end, settle with the sunlit facades larger and dominant in frame.

models.positive_prompt: Gently dolly forward toward the apartment complex while the trees stir lightly and pedestrians cross at an unhurried pace; finish with the warm-lit towers prominent in the frame.
models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for a restrained, continuous dolly-in centered on the middle tower and its neighboring buildings. Let the foreground greenery move softly and the existing pedestrians progress naturally, without introducing new activity. The push reaches a calm endpoint close to the final frames, with the residential complex visibly more prominent and still conveying settled urban comfort.

models.positive_prompt: Slowly push in toward the residential towers; leaves move softly and the existing pedestrians continue across the plaza. End with the warm-lit apartment complex prominently framed.
models.scene_plan: For this four-second shot, use a concise smooth push-in aimed at the central towers. Begin immediately, keep the motion steady, and retain only subtle visible environmental movement in the trees and plaza. Reach the endpoint near the end with the illuminated residential complex larger, centered, and fully recognizable.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A desirable modern city home feels like a real and considered purchase opportunity.
structured_intent.primary_action: The camera steadily approaches the residential complex.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The complex remains a calm, attractive symbol of comfortable urban living throughout.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The warm-lit apartment towers are prominently framed and clearly recognizable in the final moment.
